planets.name: HR 858 d
planets.description: HR 858 d crosses its star every 11.2 days and is 2.0 times as wide as Earth, found in 2019.

text.card: HR 858 d was found in 2019 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around HR 858. Its orbit and size follow Bonfanti et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
